algorithm: shared-backbone ACT variant co-trained on paired egocentric human video and teleoperated bimanual robot demonstrations, with dual pose-space and joint-space action heads
hand: parallel-jaw gripper (not a dexterous hand; see note scope flag)
headline_metric: task point score (Pts) and full-task success rate (SR) vs. ACT and Mimicplay baselines
headline_value: Laundry Pts/SR: EgoMimic 114/88% vs. ACT 82/55% vs. Mimicplay 78/50%; Groceries Pts/SR: 110/30% vs. ACT 82/22%; Object-in-Bowl Pts: 128 vs. ACT 39 (228% relative improvement) (Table III); removing human data drops score 47% (Table IV)
human_data: own egocentric video via Project Aria glasses (self-collected, not a public dataset); per-task counts: 1400 demos/60 min (Object-in-Bowl), 160 demos/80 min (Groceries), 590 demos/100 min (Laundry)
operator_interface: human data: head-worn Project Aria glasses (egocentric RGB + onboard SLAM/hand-tracking, no glove or exoskeleton); robot demonstrations: standard bimanual ViperX teleoperation
retargeting_objective: no per-finger kinematic retargeting (end effector is a 2-finger gripper); domain alignment via a shared per-timestep camera-centered reference frame, per-embodiment Gaussian normalization of proprioception/actions, and SAM2-based visual masking with a directional line overlay applied identically to human and robot streams
